instance.model: Gaussian location mixture, unit noise, priors on [-A,A]
instance.scale h: total-variation budget on the two mixtures
instance.grade K: number of matched prior moments; K=0 is the ungraded calculus
instance.method: exact LP over a discretised support (HiGHS), theta grid m up to 801, x grid dx=0.02 over [-A-8,A+8]

best_approximation_duality.statement: with the TV budget slack, Delta_K must equal 2 A E_K(|u|)
best_approximation_duality.verdict: PASS - measure-side LP and approximation-side LP agree to 5 digits and converge as the grid refines

grid_stability.note: reported deficit ratios carry roughly +-0.05 to 0.1 percent grid uncertainty

tv_reverification.note: TV of every returned pair recomputed on a 4x finer x grid; ratio to budget within 1.001 for h >= 1e-8, degrading to 0.90-0.94 at h=1e-9 (HiGHS feasibility tolerance floor 1e-10)

Q1_direction_of_Delta_K_in_K.numeric: 0 violations across 198 (A,K,h) cells; largest step up 1.7e-12, i.e. numerical zero
Q1_direction_of_Delta_K_in_K.structural_reason: the grade-(K+1) feasible set is a subset of the grade-K set at the same h and support, so monotonicity is forced by nesting and is not an empirical question at all; the hypothesis GradeSound is a theorem for any nested reading of the modulus
Q1_direction_of_Delta_K_in_K.resolution_of_the_stated_tension: moment matching does buy small TV -- e.g. at A=1 the grade-8 optimum has TV 4.8e-7 while the grade-0 optimum has TV 2.1e-1 -- but that cannot raise the supremum, because a grade-K construction is always available to the grade-0 sup. Indistinguishability is a constraint that is being satisfied, not a budget being earned.

Q2_claimed_shape_h_to_the_bK_over_2_with.finding: the fitted exponent is grade-INDEPENDENT to within 0.7 percent, so b_K*K grows linearly instead of being constant; the b_order field b_K*K = b_1 is falsified in this instance

growing_support_A_h_eq_c_sqrt_log_1_over.finding: b_K is measured NEGATIVE at every grade, i.e. the deficit ratio SHRINKS toward 1 as h decreases instead of growing polynomially

fixed_support_A3.verdict: at fixed support the envelope is 1/log(1/h), not 1/sqrt(log(1/h))

growing_support_c_0.7_1.0_1.5.verdict: growing the support at the scale the module names does bend the exponent from ~1.0 toward 0.5, reaching 0.74; over the accessible range (log(1/h) from 4.6 to 20.7) the two shapes fit equally badly (~22 percent) and cannot be separated. The envelope is NOT REFUTED but is NOT CONFIRMED asymptotically: a fitted 0.74 > 0.5 would eventually break any fixed constant.

Q4_the_headline_gap.claim: gradeGap_lower_bound: Delta_0/Delta_K >= envelopeConst * n^{b_K/2} / sqrt(log n), polynomial at every fixed grade
Q4_the_headline_gap.verdict: FAILS in this instance. The ratio collapses to 1 and stays there; at h=1e-9 a grade-8 certificate recovers 99.93 percent of the ungraded modulus. There is no polynomial gap, and by isComplete_iff_gradeInsensitive that means every fixed grade is very nearly COMPLETE here -- the opposite of part (III).

mechanism.statement: statistical closeness already implies approximate moment matching, so the moment constraints are not binding at small h
mechanism.reading: the modulus is graded by a constraint that becomes vacuous exactly in the regime the theory is about. A grading that is nearly free is a grading that certifies nearly everything.

conceptual_note.issue: the module grades two-point, Assouad, Fano and moment-matched constructions by the number of matched moments, higher meaning more constrained and therefore weaker. In practice moment-matched fuzzy hypotheses are the STRONGEST of those four, and they are strong because they permit rich many-atom priors that a two-point argument cannot use. The binding restriction that makes a two-point argument weak is the support size, not the moment count.
conceptual_note.consequence: the LP-measured direction (weaker with more moments) is correct for the definition as written, but that definition does not order the four named methods by power.

what_survives: GradeSound is not merely satisfiable, it is automatic under nesting - the eventual quantifier in the architecture instance may be unnecessarily weak
Part IV (deficit_eq_modulus_ratio_sq, isComplete_iff_gradeInsensitive) is pure algebra and untouched by any of this
Part II's Donoho-Liu bound is comfortably satisfied here: the measured grade-2 deficit is 1.00 to 1.05 at small h, far inside 5/4
what_could_not_be_tested: whether some other functional or model realises the claimed shape; only F = E|theta| in a Gaussian location mixture was measured
the true h -> 0 asymptotics: the LP is trustworthy to h = 1e-8 (HiGHS feasibility floor 1e-10) and the fitted envelope exponent is soft over 4.5 e-folds of log(1/h)
the discretised support could in principle miss a construction requiring finer atomic structure; grid refinement to m=801 moved answers by under 0.1 percent
